method: built-in image_gen; historical bounded pilot sources, no new generation during material follow-up

items.prompt: Use case product-mockup. Single small ordinary motel wall sconce, proposed pilot decoration only, on actual TRANSPARENT background. Photographic realism, inexpensive well-maintained mid-century utilitarian fixture, a shallow warm ivory opal-glass half-dome shade with a small smoked bronze wall plate and short modest support. No ornate styling, no logos, writing, wall, room, wires or second fixture. Fixed orthographic near-frontal view looking down18degrees, horizontal alignment, full complete silhouette. Soft warm-white bulb visible diffusely through lower glass; cream material with subtle wear at metal joints, no orange halo/glow/background pixels or cast shadow outside object. Small practical light, not an elaborate decorative lamp. Crisp credible material boundaries and restrained natural detail. This will be inserted as the only added fixture above the desk, with illumination supplied separately.
items.usage: Look reference only; final fixture is explicitly modeled in the saved Blender pilot.

items.prompt:
Use case precise-object-edit / constrained photographic material finishing. EDIT ONLY this cropped measured room fragment. This is not a new room. Keep the camera projection, image bounds, all silhouettes, straight edges, furniture dimensions and positions EXACTLY fixed. Door at left, small writing table and chair at right, bag as subdued context on floor. Tabletop stays COMPLETELY EMPTY: no radio, papers, objects or lamp added. No person.
Finish selected surfaces as a restrained believable photographic raster composite instead of flat textured rectangles. Door: quietly worn smoked-teal enamel with shallow existing frame bevels, plausible edge/contact wear near the EXISTING small brass horizontal handle at its exact position. No new panels, knobs, number or lock. Desk: warm ivory low-sheen laminate with a fine timber edge and natural walnut legs; preserve the existing top thickness and every leg edge/position. Chair: its existing plain rectangular burgundy upholstered back and seat supported by wood/painted legs, fine fabric weave, subtle seam/piping INSIDE current outline, no new arms or changed back shape. Floor: calm fine walnut boards, physically modest grain and unobtrusive joints, coherent soft contact shadows. Wall: quiet dusty salmon/peach plaster, mostly smooth rest with tiny fine imperfections, NOT red or uniformly cracked.
Use the same warm local light influence from above the desk, softly fading to readable plum/indigo ambient; no hard sunlight or dramatic black shadows. Natural variation in material detail density and credible small highlights at use edges. Realistic laminate/paint/wood/cloth, no painterly smoothing, game concept brushwork, obvious tiling, uniform noise/sharpen or new clutter. Do NOT add a light fixture; supplied separately. No text/logos/readable clues. Keep original room/camera/geometry; this image supplies bounded interior finishing patches to masks, not architecture.
items.usage: Never a runtime room plate. Existing saved Blender source mixes a bounded door-front albedo patch at30percent; silhouettes controlled by unchanged mesh.
